displayIdentity.body: Assigned limits restrain boasting. But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you. For it isn’t he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.
displayIdentity.title: Assigned limits restrain boasting
